title: allophylus excelsus
intro: Allophylus excelsus, commonly known as African pear, is a species of plant in the Sapindaceae family, native to tropical Africa. This plant has been traditionally used for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, diarrhea, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Allophylus excelsus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Allophylus excelsus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
